outcome: Proportion of cesarean section after induction of labor
cohort: 3772 women with mixed parity who underwent induction of labor at Soderhospital, Stockholm, between 2009-2010 and 2012-2013
finding: A higher BMI (25-34.9) was associated with an increased risk of cesarean section after induction of labor, with parity being the strongest risk factor regardless of other variables.
mod_finding: The study found a higher BMI increased the risk of cesarean section after induction of labor in women with a BMI between 25 and 34.9.
